import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import tempfile

records = []
for mode in ("factory", "builder"):
    for phase in ("before", "after"):
        source = pathlib.Path(f"{phase}-{mode}.swift")
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="constructor-swift-") as scratch:
            binary = pathlib.Path(scratch) / "program"
            command = ["xcrun", "swiftc", str(source), "-o", str(binary)]
            compiled = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
            record = {
                "mode": mode,
                "phase": phase,
                "source": str(source),
                "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                "compiler_argv": command[:-1] + ["<swift-run>/program"],
                "compiler_exit": compiled.returncode,
                "compiler_stdout": compiled.stdout.replace(scratch, "<swift-run>"),
                "compiler_stderr": compiled.stderr.replace(scratch, "<swift-run>"),
            }
            if compiled.returncode == 0:
                ran = subprocess.run([str(binary)], capture_output=True, text=True)
                record.update(runtime_exit=ran.returncode, stdout=ran.stdout, stderr=ran.stderr)
            records.append(record)
            print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)

valid = all(r["compiler_exit"] == 0 and r.get("runtime_exit") == 0 for r in records)
for mode in ("factory", "builder"):
    pair = [r for r in records if r["mode"] == mode]
    valid = valid and pair[0].get("stdout") == pair[1].get("stdout")
raise SystemExit(0 if valid else 1)
